description: Repère de nivellement du Cantal is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoh.conterra. All the benchmarks of General Leveling of France (NGF) on the department of Cantal. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Map visualisation service (WMS) of the dataset: Cantal Leveling Benchmark" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS 1.3.0, WMS 1.1.1. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2019-04-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
